ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 21 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly still mixed. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 21).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): uptrend. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 11 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 11 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 21 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量开始上翘；3 日线向上交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 11 周 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal triggered 5 trading days ago (~2026-06-11), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score +45/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于 5 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-11），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 +45/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+34）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: MillerKnoll, Incorporated, doing business as Herman Miller, is an American company that produces office furniture, equipment, and home furnishings. Its best known designs include the Aeron chair, Noguchi table, Marshmallow sofa, Mirra chair, and Eames Lounge Chair.

reads.label: Earnings quality
reads.detail: accruals trending up over 6 fiscal years — earnings increasingly not cash-backed
reads.detail_zh: 应计利润在 6 个财年间走高——盈利的现金支撑减弱

reads.label: Working capital

reads.label: Pricing power

accounting_quality.basis_zh: 多年趋势 + 同业排名
accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

cautions: earnings in 5d — binary event, size down
cautions_zh: 5天后财报 — 二元事件，减仓

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

selection.kind_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.46 ± 0.26 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.46 ± 0.26——精度中。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
